image_description: A bassoon standing vertically in a display case with a blue plaid background. The instrument features a long, reddish-brown wooden body with silver metal keys and mechanisms. The bell points upward, and the U-shaped structure is visible. A small label is visible on the right side of the glass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long wooden wind instrument of considerable height when assembled.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a tall, vertical wooden instrument consistent with the height of a bassoon.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinctive U-shape when viewed from front with bell pointing upward.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The boot joint at the bottom creates the characteristic U-turn, and the bell section rises parallel to the wing joint, pointing upward.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Conical bore that doubles back on itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The internal bore structure is not visible from the exterior; this feature cannot be visually verified without an X-ray or cutaway view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Curved metal bocal mouthpiece tube at top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A curved metal tube (bocal) is inserted into the top of the wing joint, extending outward.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Numerous metal keys and tone holes distributed along length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Complex silver keywork and rods are clearly visible along the wooden body sections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bell flares outward at top and instrument held diagonally across body when played.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bell at the top left flares correctly. While not being played, the diagonal orientation relative to the case suggests the typical playing angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dark reddish-brown polished wood finish maple or rosewood.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wood exhibits a deep reddish-brown hue with a polished sheen, consistent with maple or rosewood used for bassoons.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal keys are silver or gold-plated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The keys reflect light with a silver/chrome appearance, matching standard bassoon hardware.
The main body segments are clearly constructed from turned wood.

artifact_observations.location: Small label on the right side of the display case glass
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a small rectangular label on the glass to the right of the instrument. The text on it is illegible and appears as blurry smudges rather than distinct characters, a common AI artifact in rendering small text.
The plaid pattern on the back wall shows slight waviness and inconsistency in line straightness, particularly near the edges, suggesting minor generative distortion in the texture mapping.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument and distinguish it from similar woodwinds like the contrabassoon or oboe.
To verify that the complex keywork is physically attached to the wooden body and not floating or fused incorrectly, and to check for edge bleeding against the background.
To ensure the instrument sits correctly within the 3D space of the display case and that the glass reflections/refractions are geometrically plausible.
To specifically analyze the illegible text artifact identified by the Router and determine if it constitutes a significant failure in text rendering.

focus_areas: Integrity of the keywork mechanism (are keys connected to rods properly?)
Continuity of the wooden joints (do the sections connect seamlessly?)
Legibility and structure of the text label on the right
Geometric consistency of the plaid background pattern
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points between the metal keys and the wooden body. AI often fails to render the intricate rod-and-key mechanics correctly, resulting in 'floating' keys or melted connections. Also, scrutinize the text label; if it is complete gibberish, note it as a definitive artifact. Verify if the bocal insertion point looks physically valid.
